description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must assign two available pallet positions on today's routine airlift among three approved sustainment cargoes, designate the aircraft's single powered position, and record the coordination actions needed before loading.

shared_context.S1: Today's scheduled aircraft has two available pallet positions, and only one of those positions provides continuous electrical power during flight.
shared_context.S2: Three approved cargoes are staged for consideration: medical vaccine cases, an avionics diagnostic module, and water-purification cartridges.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez signs the final pallet allocation and loading instructions.
shared_context.S4: The airfield loadmaster requires the weekly logistics huddle before each lift so the responsible staff sections can confirm cargo handling and coordination requirements.

PF1.text: The staged vaccine cases must remain in the aircraft's powered pallet position for the entire flight; Lt. Morgan confirmed this requirement with the clinic cold-chain custodian this morning, but the updated handling note has not yet been added to the lift manifest.

PF2.text: The avionics diagnostic module is a loaned higher-headquarters asset, and the loan record directs that it return on the next available aircraft; SFC Patel received the signed loan-record update from maintenance control this morning, but it has not yet been posted to the battalion cargo board.

acceptance_conditions: The vaccine cases must occupy one of the two pallet positions and the cold-chain requirement must be recorded.
The avionics diagnostic module must occupy one of the two pallet positions and its higher-headquarters loan return must be coordinated.
The vaccine cases must be assigned to the powered position.
The water-purification cartridges must be identified as the deferred cargo.
The plan must include a manifest update, a cold-chain confirmation citing PF1, and a distinct higher-headquarters loan-return coordination action reflecting PF2.
The medical cold-chain requirement must be cited in the justification.
The higher-headquarters loan-return directive must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'medical vaccine cases' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'medical vaccine cases') and any(c['type'] == 'cold_chain_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'medical vaccine cases' and c['detail'] == 'PF1: vaccine cases must remain in the powered pallet position for the entire flight' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C2: (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'avionics diagnostic module' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'avionics diagnostic module') and any(c['type'] == 'loan_return_coordination' and c['target'] == 'higher headquarters' and c['detail'] == 'PF2: return the loaned avionics diagnostic module on the next available aircraft' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The vaccine handling requirement changes the powered-position assignment to exactly medical vaccine cases and requires the manifest and cold-chain actions to record PF1.

The higher-headquarters loan directive changes the selected second cargo to exactly avionics diagnostic module, makes water-purification cartridges the deferred cargo, and requires a loan-return action citing PF2.
